calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 22 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY lfl_growth_pct DESC;

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
dups AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id || '-' || f.line_no) AS distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.fiscal_week, ROUND(m.mine,2) AS mine, ROUND(c.ctl,2) AS ctl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctl,2) AS gap, du.lines, du.distinct_lines, du.distinct_ids
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) JOIN dups du USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
ORDER BY 1,2;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) AS amts, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS prods, COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores,
         MIN(sales_line_id) AS min_id, MAX(sales_line_id) AS max_id, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_etl, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_etl, MIN(sale_date) AS min_date, MAX(sale_date) AS max_date
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_keys, SUM(n) AS rows_in_dup_keys, MAX(n) AS max_n, MAX(amts) AS max_amts, MAX(prods) AS max_prods, MAX(stores) AS max_stores,
       MIN(min_date) AS from_date, MAX(max_date) AS to_date, MIN(min_etl) AS first_etl, MAX(max_etl) AS last_etl
FROM d;

    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
sales_dedup AS (
    -- the 15-21 Sep 2025 receipt lines were loaded twice; keep one row per receipt line
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key

    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key

    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales DESC) AS rank,
       ty.region,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year

WITH sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cs.region, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN n.net_sales END),2) AS ty,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN n.net_sales END),2) AS ly,
       ROUND(100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN n.net_sales END)/SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN n.net_sales END)-1),2) AS growth_pct
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY growth_pct DESC;
